questions.markdown:
A stable system has the indicated input $x(t)$ and output $y(t)$. Use Laplace transforms to determine the transfer function and impulse response of the system.

(i) $x(t)=e^{-t}u(t),\ y(t)=e^{-2t}\cos(t)u(t)$

(ii) $x(t)=e^{-2t}u(t),\ y(t)=-2e^{-t}u(t)+2e^{-3t}u(t)$

Let $x(t)$ and $y(t)$ are given below:

Sketch the following signals:

(i). $x(t)y(t-1)$

(ii). $x(t)y(2-t)$

(iii). $x(2t)y\!\left(\frac{1}{2}t+1\right)$
